# PR #5055: Patch: a greyed Marketplace Buy answers a press with the engine's reason

Closes #5010

## What changed

Pressing a greyed Buy in the Marketplace now shows the offer's engine `reason` as a line under that button and sends nothing. A live Buy still sends its listed `marketBuy`. This is the board-wide rule from R3768000, which a greyed Activate or Trade already follows.

- **`Marketplace.tsx`**: the greyed Buy is now `aria-disabled` instead of a native `disabled`. A native disabled button takes no tap on a phone, and that was the dead end. A press on it records the view it was made on, and `Offer` draws a `role="status"` line, `market-reason-<offer>`, while that view is still the one shown.
- **No stored words, no client wording**: the line reads `t(offer.reason)` off the same view while it draws, as the tooltip does. An offer with no `reason` shows nothing, as `TradeButton` does.
- **The line goes** with the next view (any new view object, as Game's `notice.view === shown` does) or when the panel closes, because `pressedOn` lives in each lot's state. There is no `useEffect` and no new suppression.
- **`contract.ts`**: adds `testid.marketReason(offer)`.
- **`market.css`**: the greying selector `.marketplace-deal:disabled` becomes `.marketplace-deal[aria-disabled="true"]`, and `.marketplace-reason` is new, using only existing custom properties.
- **Docs**: one sentence each in the `apps/web/README.md` Marketplace paragraph and in spec §10.10, the latter citing the existing R3768000.
- **No new ruling, no `spec/pending` file, no new string** (so `zh-CN.json` is untouched), nothing outside `apps/web` and that one spec line.

## Tests

In `Marketplace.test.tsx`, two existing assertions that read `.disabled` now read `aria-disabled` (the greyed Buy is focusable), and the live-Buy test also asserts no line. Six new tests, all titled `R1853003 …`, cover:
- a press shows exactly the view's words under its own lot, with `role="status"`, and sends nothing;
- a greyed Buy stays focusable;
- an offer with no `reason` says nothing, and Buy 1 still reads its own `reason` with an empty `legal`;
- a new view drops the line and a new press brings it back;
- a Buy that goes live after a press loses its line and sends its listed `marketBuy`;
- closing and reopening the shop drops the line.
